thread:
sanjay: incident-bot just paged on high GPU queue growth in eu-prod-gpu, queue depth spiking across pods > 95% for 5m, users seeing 503s :rotating_light:
incident-bot: [ALERT] eu-prod-gpu queue-length > 950 (threshold 500) — autoscaler not responding — check metrics pipeline and HPA metrics adapter.
alex: on it, pulling dashboard now. any immediate customer reports?
taylor: saw a spike in inference retries from a few customer apps, looks like throttling kicked in around 17:22 UTC.
mar ia: (typo) sorry, panicking fingers — we have two big batch jobs from partner-tenant-3 that saturated pools.
sanjay: OK, quick triage — suspects: Prometheus adapter lag or metrics-server overload preventing HPA scale decisions. check prometheus-adapter logs and metrics-server CPU.
alex: kubectl top nodes shows GPUs at 98% mem, pods Pending with reason=InsufficientGPU, queue backlog strongly correlated.
incident-bot: deploy-bot started 1 rollback in the last 30m — not related but noted.
taylor: checking prometheus-adapter: `kubectl logs -n monitoring prometheus-adapter-0` shows 504s to prometheus and series-exhaustion errors. adapter metrics show scrape_latency spikes.
mar ia: metrics-server is OOMKilled on a couple monitoring nodes earlier — restarted automatically by k8s, but backlog grew during restart.
sanjay: mitigation plan quick list: 1) enable emergency reserved-pool (dedicated burst) 2) manually scale GPU pool up 3) reduce per-request concurrency (throttle) for non-critical tenants 4) restart prometheus-adapter with higher replicas and bump scrape timeout 5) notify support & customers.
alex: executing step 2 and 4 now. command: ```kubectl -n infra scale deployment gpu-nodepool --replicas=8``` then ```kubectl -n monitoring scale deployment prometheus-adapter --replicas=3```
taylor: also adding a temporary rule to the HPA metrics source fallback: if custom metrics delayed >30s, fallback to request-rate based heuristic. patch: ```kubectl patch hpa inference --patch '{"spec":{"behavior":{}}}'``` (will post exact).
mar ia: rate-limiting non-critical tenants now: flipping feature-flag `tenant_throttle` for partner-tenant-3 and analytics-queue -> reduced incoming job rate by ~60% in next 2m.
incident-bot: pagerduty: escalated to oncall@redwood with priority P1 at 17:28 UTC.
sanjay: customer impact summary so far: ~3% of production inference requests experienced 5xx between 17:20-17:40 UTC, highest impact on partner-tenant-3 and some bursty PLG customers. Not a full outage but degraded latency and retries.
alex: prometheus-adapter replicas up and healthy. logs show adapter catching up, API errors dropping.
taylor: HPA still not scaling automatically — looks like the custom metric series names changed during restart (label normalization). pushing a hotfix to adapter config to accept both legacy and new series names.
mar ia: manual scale completed, new GPU nodes registering, scheduler placing pending pods. queue depth dropping from 980 -> 320 over the past 6m.
sanjay: good. keep monitoring for throttling events and GPU paging. we should avoid letting queue spike back. enable prefix cache bypass for long-run batch jobs in gateways.
alex: applied adapter config patch: `kubectl apply -f prometheus-adapter-hotfix.yaml` — adapter now exposing custom metrics with expected names. HPA metrics show values, autoscaler observed desired replicas but capped by scaleLimit=12 (config) — we hit scale limit.
taylor: scaleLimit bite — ops-policy restricts to 12, current pool at 12, even with desire=20. can we temporarily raise limit?
sanjay: yes, we have emergency override. increasing pool scaleLimit to 30 for 30m. doing it now: ```PATCH /v1/nodepools/eu-prod-gpu {"scaleLimit":30}```
mar ia: override applied. new nodes booting, ETA ~4m.
incident-bot: note: billing-alert suppressed for emergency override per policy.
alex: new nodes joined, autoscaler created additional replicas, pending pods scheduling, queue dropping below 100 now.
sanjay: customer impact update: degraded period ~20m, peak 3% affected, now mitigated. support already notified top 5 affected customers with incident advisory.
taylor: followups: - postmortem to include root cause (metrics-server OOM + prometheus-adapter label drift + conservative scale limits), detection gaps (no fallback check to request-rate), and playbook update for emergency scaleLimit override.
mar ia: I'll open the incident page and link dashboards and commands used. tagging infra, monitoring, product for customer comms.
sanjay: handoff: alex, you'll run the 4-hour watch, check that HPA returns to normal behavior and that we don't exceed cost guardrails. if stable, hand off to taylor at 22:00 UTC.
alex: acknowledged. summary for handoff message I'll post in 10m.
incident-bot: reminder — please file the follow-up ticket in #postmortems and assign to oncall rotation.
sanjay: thanks team. closing active mitigation thread but leaving monitoring open. final note: don't revert adapter hotfix until we've validated series stability across clusters. :white_check_mark:
